title: Cragmaw Castle · Area 14 · King’s quarters

sourceRecords.title: Area 14 · Grol and Vyerith
read: Voices cut through the door: a harsh demand, then a smooth reply. Inside, furs cover the floor while a towering bugbear argues with a dark-clad visitor.

The argument reveals different voices, not an agreement you understand yet. The furs and the speakers' positions divide the room into places to approach or avoid. You can listen for a few more words, announce yourselves, or look for a position that keeps your way out clear.

brief: King Grol quarters: thick fur rugs, old trophies, large NORTH bed, bright coal brazier, round table/chairs SOUTH. ONE old hunched bugbear King Grol, ONE ordinary wolf Snarl, ONE apparent female drow Vyerith in discussion. CURRENT campaign Gundren is at inn, so NO dwarf prisoner. Glasstaff known DM-only to have fled here, omit him in public base image. No exposed doppelganger or castle route text.
